**This is a builder issue tracker.**  
Do not report patch bugs, patch requests or app-specific problems here. Report
those to the patches project (ReVanced, Morphe, anddea, etc.).

Please include:

- `./build.sh --check` output
- the app table from `config.toml`
- the full build log (`build.md` or terminal output)
- Android/root manager version (if the issue is at install time)
- the module zip name and `module.prop` (if relevant)
